name: Lion
description: A lion is a powerful and majestic big cat known for its mane and prowess as a predator. It is often found in savannas and grasslands, where it dominates the food chain as one of the apex predators.

actions.name: Tackle
actions.description: After using the Move action and ending adjacent to another creature after at least 4 units of movement, the lion launches itself at a creature, dealing physical damage and knocking any medium or smaller creatures prone.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: The lion bites a creature, dealing physical damage. If the target is both prone, this attack deals an additional 1d6 damage.

actions.name: Trip
actions.description: When a creature leaves the lion's area of control, it makes an improvised melee attack to attempt to trip the creature. The target must make an acrobatics or athletics check greater than or equal to the attack check or fall prone and lose the rest of their movement for that action.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: The lion mauls a creature, dealing physical damage. In the event of a true hit, the target gains the bleeding condition if they took damage after mitigations.

traits.name: Defense of the Pride
traits.description: When the lion enters an enagement, it gains temporary health equal to the amount of allies it has within an 8 unit radius that lasts until the end of combat.
